title: Kill Collar

sources.title: Motivator
markers: | description = '''Prinski's Motivator''', also known as '''Motivator''', is a device carried by Banite [[Black Gauntlet]] cultists in the [[Steel Watch Foundry]].

summary: Wearing the collar in the Lower Foundry kills the wearer if a Motivator activates.

fields.Trigger: Equip it in the Lower Foundry of the Steel Watch Foundry. If a Black Gauntlet’s Motivator is allowed to activate, the wearer explodes and dies immediately. Other activation circumstances replace it with Destroyed Kill Collar.
fields.Motivator: Disable a dropped or activated Motivator with a DC 5 Intelligence check. The source reports that directing follower Toobin to deactivate it spends his Action without disabling it.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
